_note: Discourse marker rotation. Each key is a marker and each value is a set of substitutes that can stand in the same slot in a sentence. A substitute must be an in-sentence adverbial, not a sentence-level connective, so that it does not change the syntax. Do not add a phrase that appears on the audit's machine-phrase list.
